snippet.title: Divinest Light - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Get the game on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1371700/Divinest_Light

itch.io: https://glebmirolyubov.itch.io/divinest-light

GameJolt: https://gamejolt.com/games/divinest-light/519399

Divinest Light is an atmospheric puzzle-platformer set in the mysterious and dark world with a unique shadow-avoidance mechanic.

You are descended to earth by the Divinest Light. Your past is unclear, but the Light gives you strength to proceed through the darkness of void. Embrace it and try to uncover the secrets of this monochromatic world.

Developed by Gleb Mirolyubov, composed by Alex Krownway.

Out now on Steam, itch.io, and GameJolt. Available for Windows, MacOS, and Linux+SteamOS platforms.
